title: Deny and Recover Two Passes Away
description: A defender two passes away from the ball practises sinking into help position, then recovering out to deny as the ball gets closer.

content.objective: Adjust position correctly as the ball's distance from your matchup changes.
content.setup: Three offensive players pass around the perimeter against their defenders, focusing on the farthest defender from the ball.
instructions: When the ball is two passes away, the defender sinks into the lane for help position.
As the ball gets passed closer, that same defender recovers out toward a denial position.
Continue reading and adjusting position with every pass.
Rotate which defender is being observed every two minutes.
coachingPoints: See both the ball and your player at all times.
Move with every pass, not just when the ball comes directly to your player.
Keep a stance that lets you move quickly in either direction.
commonMistakes: Ball-watching and losing track of your own player's movement.
Staying in denial position even when two passes away, leaving no help.
Talking too little for teammates to react in time.
content.safety: Hands stay in passing lanes only, never grabbing an offensive player.
